 Cianne Dominguez, Nicole Fortuna evicted from 'PBB' house
 Drew Acierto ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 21, 2026 07:37 PM PHT 
 “Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0” housemates Cianne Dominguez and Nicole Fortuna are the latest evictees from the reality show. 
 Dominguez and Fortuna ended their stay inside the “PBB” house after being the two housemates that received the least number of votes among the nominated housemates as revealed by the show’s hosts.  
 Known as the Madlang Babe ng Antipolo, Dominguez received 3.98% of the total public votes, while Fortuna, the Pretty Dependable Ate ng Bohol had 23.92% of votes.
 The two expressed what their experience was like inside the “PBB” house. 
 ADVERTISEMENT
 “Si Cianne Dominguez ay natuto ng sobra,” Dominguez said.
 “I had the best four weeks of my life in Kuya’s house,” Fortuna added. 
 Meanwhile, “PBB” housemates Nathan Garcia, Primo Alterado, Raheel Bhyria, and Bela Arcal  are all safe from eviction.
